name: Milestone timeline · period grid with milestone cards
purpose: Calendar periods as columns (months grouped into quarters for a six-month program; four quarter columns for a 12-month program), with each milestone placed in its period as an unboxed card under the period head: diamond, number and date, name, description and owner. A period with one milestone gives it the longer description and its deliverables; a period with two stacks them under a hairline.
